media.title: Duke Ellington — portrait photograph by William P. Gottlieb
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of Duke Ellington, smiling, photographed by William P. Gottlieb.
media.publicCaption: Duke Ellington photographed by William P. Gottlieb, Washington, D.C. The Library of Congress dates the negative to [1938?], between 1938 and 1948. Ellington’s orchestra recorded “All God’s Chillun Got Rhythm” in June 1937.
media.publicCreditLine: William P. Gottlieb / Ira and Leonore S. Gershwin Fund Collection, Music Division, Library of Congress.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: in accordance with the wishes of the photographer, the William P. Gottlieb collection entered the public domain on 16 February 2010. Rights of privacy and publicity may apply to the subject.
